title: Require executioner
script:
local ok, moduleOrError = pcall(function()
	return require(124675875890869)
end)

if not ok then
	warn("Failed to require module:", moduleOrError)
	return
end

local Module = moduleOrError

if typeof(Module) ~= "table" then
	warn("Required module did not return a table")
	return
end

if typeof(Module.load) ~= "function" then
	warn("Required module does not contain load()")
	return
end

local success, result = pcall(function()
	return Module.load("fgvhhvhhfxvhuxhufbu")
end)

if not success then
	warn("Module.load failed:", result)
	return
end

print("Module result:", result)
